content.overview: Section 5 provides for pre-litigation mediation before a party files a suit or proceeding to which the Act applies.
content.glance: Section 5 provides for pre-litigation mediation before a party files a suit or proceeding to which the Act applies.
content.study: Parties may, and in the cases covered by the Act must, attempt pre-litigation mediation before approaching the court. The object is settlement without a contested proceeding. Full statutory text and commencement remain to be verified against an authoritative Act source (India Code retrieval previously returned HTTP 403).
